title: Anthropic's Skills repository remains GitHub's biggest AI trend of the day
friendlyTitle: Anthropic shares ready-made skills for AI agents
summary: Anthropic's public collection of Agent Skills has about 174,000 stars and was the strongest AI-related repository in today's collected GitHub trends. It includes reusable document, spreadsheet, presentation and development procedures plus a template for writing custom skills.
friendlySummary: This popular repository contains reusable instructions that teach agents how to handle documents, spreadsheets, presentations and other tasks.
whyItMatters: Use the repository to study how focused instructions, scripts and resources can package a repeatable workflow for an agent. Review every skill before installation, especially any script or instruction that can access files, credentials or external services.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can copy its patterns to make your own repeatable AI workflows. Read the files and scripts before giving a skill access to your computer.
